subject: Momentum discount: stepdown, clawback & ramp breakpoint proposal
messages:
From: Tyler Nguyen <tyler@polarishealth.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Emma Li <emma@polarishealth.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Multi-year prepay — looking to lock a 3yr structure with stepdown/clawback questions

Rishi,

Thanks again for the demo last week — Polaris is excited by the latency/cost story. We shared an initial budget with Finance and theyre inclined toward a multi-year prepay to secure pricing. Before we move an LOI to procurement we need clarity on two commercial mechanics:

- Stepdown schedule: can Redwood provide a structured stepdown after year 1 (e.g., 18% Y1 -> 14% Y2 -> 10% Y3) if we commit to a 3-year upfront?
- Clawback / true-up: Finance is wary of aggressive clawbacks for usage shortfalls. They prefer a smoothing true-up window (30–60 days) and a cap on clawback to protect budgeting.

High-level ask: can you provide a proposal that includes (a) a 3-year prepay discount profile, (b) ramp breakpoints tied to usage thresholds, and (c) clear clawback caps? If possible, include an option for an annualized prepay (2-year) for comparison.

Target timeline: Polaris wants commercial terms that we can share with procurement by Jan 6.

Thanks —
Tyler
Director, Infrastructure
Polaris Health

Attachments: none
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Tyler Nguyen <tyler@polarishealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 28 Dec 2026 13:45:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: Multi-year prepay — looking to lock a 3yr structure with stepdown/clawback questions

Tyler — really appreciate the clarity on requirements. Drafted a short proposal attached (Polaris_Prepay_Proposal_v2.pdf) with two tracks: 3-year and 2-year. Summary:

- 3-year prepay (preferred economics): 20% effective discount year 1, stepdown to 15% year 2, 10% year 3 if invoiced upfront.
- 2-year annualized prepay: 18% year 1, 12% year 2.
- Ramp breakpoints: TF1: 0–1.25x baseline (no penalty), TF2: 1.25–1.75x (pro-rated true-up), TF3: >1.75x (overage billing at committed price).
- Clawback / true-up: 60-day true-up window post-year-end; clawback capped at 25% of prepay in Year 1, 15% in Year 2, 10% in Year 3 for the 3-year plan. We can discuss lowering caps in exchange for shorter true-up windows or reduced stepdown.

Karthik: can you confirm estimated throughput assumptions and whether the ramp breakpoints map to the workload profile Polaris showed?
Marissa: looping you for approval on the clawback caps — can we make an exception to the standard 30% cap for Year 1?

Next steps: Ill stand up a short one-page term summary once we align on the caps and breakpoints, then send for DocuSign. Delivery target to meet Tylers Jan 6 procurement ask.

Best,
Rishi
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Attachment: Polaris_Prepay_Proposal_v2.pdf (proposal stub, pricing table included)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 29 Dec 2026 08:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Internal: Polaris — clawback cap approval request

Team —

Reviewed Rishis proposal. High-level internal guidance:

- Approve pursuing the 3-year prepay as long as Year 1 clawback is capped at 25% and we retain a right to convert excess usage to overage billing (no retroactive price inflation beyond the cap). That gives Finance some predictability while preserving upside.
- For concessions: if Polaris pushes for a tighter cap (<=20% Year 1), ask for either a shorter true-up (30 days) or an increased commitment floor (minimum annual usage).
- Approve the ramp breakpoints as framed, but require Karthik to validate model assumptions and confirm GPU-hour equivalence mapping so legal can translate into SOW terms.

Rishi: proceed to present the 25/15/10 cap profile to the customer. If they push back, escalate to me with the exact request and expected revenue delta.

Thanks —
Marissa
Head of Sales, APAC & Strategic Deals

Note: internal only
From: Tyler Nguyen <tyler@polarishealth.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Emma Li <emma@polarishealth.com>
Date: Mon, 03 Jan 2027 11:23:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: Multi-year prepay — looking to lock a 3yr structure with stepdown/clawback questions

Rishi — thanks for the fast turnaround and the PDF. We reviewed with Finance; a few items:

1) Polaris likes the 3-year profile but asks that Year 1 cap be 20% (vs 25) and that Year 1 true-up be 45 days rather than 60. In return were willing to accept the stepdown schedule you proposed.
2) Ramp breakpoints look reasonable, but procurement wants an explicit safeguard: no clawback apply if usage misses projections due to a force majeure / regulatory delay clause.
3) Emma asked if we can include a limited rollover for unused committed tokens up to 10%/year (use it or carry to next year).

We attached Polaris_Redlines.docx with inline comments. Can Redwood agree to the 20% cap + 45-day true-up if we accept a reduced carryover (max 10% per year) and add the regulatory delay carveout?

If so well send an LOI and get legal to accelerate review — target procurement approval by Jan 6.

Best,
Tyler

Attachment: Polaris_Redlines.docx
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Tyler Nguyen <tyler@polarishealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 05 Jan 2027 14:08:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: Multi-year prepay — looking to lock a 3yr structure with stepdown/clawback questions

Tyler — appreciate the clear asks and the redlines. We can accept the commercial package with the following confirmed tradeoffs: 

- Clawback caps: 20% Year 1, 14% Year 2, 10% Year 3.
- True-up window: 45 days (agreed).
- Carryover: up to 10% unused committed tokens can roll forward year-to-year (non-cumulative beyond one year).
- Regulatory delay carveout: agree to waive clawback for usage shortfalls that are demonstrably caused by regulatory suspension or force majeure — must be pre-notified and validated.
- Final: DocuSign LOI & commercial sheet attached here: https://www.docusign.net/Polaris-DEAL-7832.

Marissa: please confirm final signoff for the reduced Year 1 cap as an exception to standard policy. Karthik: can you produce a short mapping doc that converts Polariss token forecast into GPU-hour commitments for the SOW? That will speed legal.

Tyler: once Marissa signs off Ill push the LOI and pricing sheet through DocuSign and share the signed stub. Well also load the deal in HubSpot (DEAL-7832).

Thanks and happy new year —
Rishi
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Attachment: Polaris_Signed_MOU_stub.pdf (placeholder once LOI is executed)
